course_name_original: Subestaciones y Técnicas de Alta Tensión

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and distinguish the different types of substations, their functions, and single-line diagrams.
Recognize, select, and dimension the electrical equipment incorporated in a high-voltage electrical substation, especially regarding renewable energies.
Prepare an insulation coordination plan to choose the insulation levels of an electrical substation, and apply overvoltage protection procedures.
Calculate and design a substation grounding system to prevent the appearance of dangerous voltages within the substation during electrical failures.

Plan the physical arrangement of the substation's electrical equipment, as well as develop, elaborate, and design projects for substation electrical installations applying technical-economic design specifications and handling mandatory regulations and standards.

syllabus_topics: Physical arrangement of substations. Environmental impact.
Insulation coordination and overvoltages. Selection of insulation level.
Conductors and busbars in high voltage.
Electrical studies. Dynamic and thermal stresses.
assessment_rules: The final grade for the ordinary and extraordinary calls will be calculated as 0.2*P1 + 0.1*P2 + 0.7*P3, where P1 is the theoretical exam, P2 is the practical evaluation, and P3 is the design project. For the extraordinary call, the practical block grade from the practices is kept, and the course project is submitted. In case of doubt regarding authorship or unauthorized means, a face-to-face defense may be requested.
bibliography: Notes and proposed problems for the subject.
Complementary documentation (notices, presentations, practices, etc.) provided by the professor.
